budgets._comment: Re-baselined when the shell replaced its overflow menu with one named nav. Every destination is now in the prerendered HTML, which is what makes them crawlable and reachable without JavaScript, so ~15 labelled rows and their icons ship in the shell instead of 6. Raised again when theme and accent joined the navigation: the sidebar's copy of the pair ships in the shell, which is ~2 KiB of icon markup raw and nothing measurable brotli. The Menu sheet's copy waits for the sheet, so it costs the shell nothing. Header settings and project links add about 1.7 KiB of raw shell markup. The complete home-page bundle flow adds about 1.4 KiB of raw semantic markup while reducing the Brotli size below this budget's compressed target. The Extract workflow adds one labelled Files row to the shell. The guided cheat tours add about 0.2 KiB of raw home-shell markup; the approved raw limit is 56,000 bytes. The file-type home page puts its file router, one-pass steps, format lists, privacy notes and FAQ in the prerendered shell so search engines can read them, bringing it to 57,082 raw and 11,378 Brotli bytes; the approved limits are 58,000 and 11,600 bytes. Buffering files picked or dropped before hydration adds an inline script of about 0.9 KiB raw and 0.3 KiB Brotli: main measured 56.4 KiB raw and 11.2 KiB Brotli in CI, and the change measured 57.3 KiB and 11.5 KiB, so the limits rise from 58,000 and 11,600 to 59,500 and 12,100 bytes.

budgets._comment: The de and es message catalogs ship as separate lazy chunks (catalog.ts CATALOG_LOADERS), fetched only when the visitor's locale resolves to one of them, so they count against their own budget instead of the main JavaScript budget. The measured build is 82,648 raw and 23,260 Brotli bytes (de 41,163 and 11,955, es 41,485 and 11,305), and the main JavaScript limits dropped by exactly those amounts. The maximums leave about 14 KiB of Brotli (about 50 KiB raw at the catalogs' 3.55:1 ratio) for the planned translation batches: roughly 8 KiB for the settings, cheat and save-tool strings and roughly 6 KiB for the forms.
